title: Analytical Procedures (MET)[Purity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (MET)[Purity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Technique
action.description: Plate-count method Ph. Eur. / USP / JP

action.title: Procedure
action.description: Determine the total aerobic microbial count (TAMC) and the total combined yeasts/moulds count (TYMC) according to the harmonized methods of Ph. Eur. 2.6.12, USP <61> and JP <4.05 I> “Microbiological Examination of Non-Sterile Products: Microbial Enumeration Tests” by the pour-plate method. For the absence of specified microorganism Escherichia coli proceed according to the harmonized methods of Ph. Eur. 2.6.13, USP <62> and JP <4.05 II> “Microbiological Examination of Non-Sterile Products: Test for Specified Micro-Organisms”.
